question_english: Two senior faculty members are in conflict regarding the scheduling of the school's solitary multimedia smart room for board examination revision. The Principal convenes a joint session where both teachers articulate their pedagogical needs, resulting in a shared timetable and collaborative cross-disciplinary digital lesson plans. Which Thomas-Kilmann conflict-handling mode did the Principal facilitate?
options_english: Competing
Avoiding
Accommodating
Collaborating
explanation_english:
According to Kenneth Thomas and Ralph Kilmann's Conflict Mode Instrument (TKI), conflict-handling behaviors are categorized along two dimensions: assertiveness (attempting to satisfy one's own concerns) and cooperativeness (attempting to satisfy the other party's concerns). The 'Collaborating' mode is high in both assertiveness and cooperativeness, embodying a 'win-win' philosophy. By facilitating open dialogue, identifying underlying pedagogical requirements, and synthesizing an integrative solution—sharing the room and co-creating cross-disciplinary lessons—the Principal led the teachers to a collaborative resolution where both parties' needs are completely met.
- Option A is incorrect because 'Competing' is assertive and uncooperative (win-lose), where one party's interests prevail at the direct expense of the other.
- Option B is incorrect because 'Avoiding' is unassertive and uncooperative (lose-lose), involving sidestepping, postponing, or ignoring the conflict altogether.
- Option C is incorrect because 'Accommodating' is unassertive and cooperative (lose-win), where one party neglects their own concerns to appease and satisfy the other party.
explanation_hindi:
केनेथ थॉमस और राल्फ किल्मन के द्वंद्व समाधान मॉडल (TKI) में द्वंद्व व्यवहार को दो आयामों पर मापा जाता है: दृढ़ता (स्वयं की चिंताओं को पूरा करने का प्रयास) और सहकारिता (दूसरे की चिंताओं को पूरा करने का प्रयास)। 'सहयोगात्मक शैली' (कोलैबोरेटिंग) उच्च दृढ़ता और उच्च सहकारिता (जीत-जीत दृष्टिकोण) का प्रतिनिधित्व करती है। यहाँ प्रधानाचार्य ने एक रचनात्मक मंच प्रदान किया जहाँ दोनों शिक्षकों की आवश्यकताओं को पूरी तरह समझा गया और एक एकीकृत समाधान (कमरे को साझा करना और संयुक्त पाठ योजनाएं तैयार करना) विकसित किया गया, जिससे दोनों पक्षों के हित पूर्णतः संतुष्ट हुए।
- विकल्प (A) गलत है क्योंकि 'प्रतिस्पर्धात्मक' शैली उच्च दृढ़ता और निम्न सहकारिता वाली होती है, जहाँ एक पक्ष दूसरे की कीमत पर जीतता है।
- विकल्प (B) गलत है क्योंकि 'परिहार' शैली में संघर्ष से बचा जाता है या उसे नजरअंदाज कर दिया जाता है।
- विकल्प (C) गलत है क्योंकि 'समायोजन' शैली में एक व्यक्ति दूसरे की संतुष्टि के लिए अपनी प्राथमिकताओं का त्याग कर देता है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (D) Collaborating

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: When two teachers face conflicting needs and the principal facilitates an open discussion to satisfy both parties through a shared schedule and joint planning, the conflict management mode employed is Collaborating. Under the Thomas-Kilmann Conflict Mode Instrument (TKM), collaboration is both assertive and cooperative (win-win), aiming to find an integrative solution that fully addresses the underlying concerns of all stakeholders.

question_english: In the context of educational governance and organizational administration, the ISO 9000 series of standards is fundamentally associated with:
options_english: Quality management systems and institutional quality assurance frameworks
Environmental sustainability, ecological safety, and green institutional benchmarks
Information technology hardware specifications and network infrastructure standards
Nutritional dietary benchmarks and food safety standards for institutional meal programs
explanation_english:
The International Organization for Standardization (ISO) 9000 series is an internationally recognized family of standards dedicated to Quality Management Systems (QMS). In educational institutions, implementing ISO 9000 (such as ISO 9001) helps schools establish standardized administrative workflows, documented standard operating procedures (SOPs), rigorous pedagogical auditing mechanisms, continuous stakeholder feedback loops, and systematic continuous quality improvement protocols. This enhances institutional efficiency, academic excellence, and accountability to learners, parents, and regulatory bodies.
- Option B is incorrect because environmental management and ecological sustainability standards are governed by the ISO 14000 series (specifically ISO 14001).
- Option C is incorrect because information security, IT hardware, and data management are governed by the ISO/IEC 27000 series.
- Option D is incorrect because food safety and nutritional management systems are covered under the ISO 22000 series.
explanation_hindi:
अंतर्राष्ट्रीय मानकीकरण संगठन (आई.एस.ओ.) की 9000 शृंखला गुणवत्ता प्रबंधन प्रणाली से संबंधित वैश्विक मानकों का एक समुच्चय है। किसी शैक्षणिक संस्थान में आई.एस.ओ. 9000 के मानकों को लागू करने से प्रशासनिक प्रक्रियाओं में मानकीकरण आता है, मानक संचालन प्रक्रियाएं निर्धारित होती हैं, शिक्षण-अधिगम गुणवत्ता का नियमित लेखापरीक्षण होता है और निरंतर सुधार की संस्कृति स्थापित होती है।
- विकल्प (B) गलत है क्योंकि पर्यावरणीय प्रबंधन और पारिस्थितिकी सुरक्षा के मानक आई.एस.ओ. 14000 शृंखला के अंतर्गत आते हैं।
- विकल्प (C) गलत है क्योंकि सूचना सुरक्षा और डेटा प्रबंधन प्रणाली के मानक आई.एस.ओ./आई.ई.सी. 27000 शृंखला द्वारा शासित होते हैं।
- विकल्प (D) गलत है क्योंकि खाद्य सुरक्षा और आहार प्रबंधन मानक आई.एस.ओ. 22000 शृंखला से संबंधित हैं।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (A) Quality management and quality assurance standards.

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: The ISO 9000 series represents an international family of standards for quality management systems (QMS). In educational institutions, adopting ISO 9000 standards helps streamline administrative processes, establish standardized operating procedures, monitor instructional delivery, and maintain consistent educational quality assurance, thereby improving organizational effectiveness and stakeholder satisfaction.

question_english: In organizational and administrative theory, the fundamental distinction between a 'Manager' and a 'Leader' posits that a Manager is primarily oriented toward:
options_english: Articulating a transformative future vision and actively challenging established institutional routines
Embracing high-stakes personal and institutional risks to pioneer radical organizational innovations
Planning, organizing, coordinating resources, and maintaining operational system stability
Cultivating intense charismatic motivation and deep emotional commitment among organizational members
explanation_english:
As formulated by classical organizational scholars such as Warren Bennis and John Kotter, management and leadership involve distinct processes and mindsets. Management is primarily focused on coping with complexity and maintaining order; a manager's primary responsibilities involve planning budgets, establishing organizational structures, organizing personnel, staffing, controlling deviations, and ensuring system stability and predictable efficiency. In contrast, leadership is focused on coping with change; a leader sets a visionary direction, aligns people, inspires commitment, and actively challenges the status quo to transform the organization.
- Option A is incorrect because envisioning long-term goals and challenging the status quo are defining hallmarks of leadership.
- Option B is incorrect because taking strategic risks and pursuing breakthrough innovations are core attributes of transformational leadership, whereas managers generally minimize risk to ensure stability.
- Option D is incorrect because charismatic inspiration and emotional alignment are characteristic of charismatic and transformational leadership.
explanation_hindi:
वॉरेन बेनिस और जॉन कोटर जैसे प्रमुख प्रबंधन विचारकों के अनुसार, प्रबंधन और नेतृत्व के कार्यों तथा दृष्टिकोण में स्पष्ट अंतर होता है। प्रबंधन का मुख्य उद्देश्य संगठनात्मक जटिलता को नियंत्रित करना और व्यवस्था बनाए रखना है; अतः एक प्रबंधक का प्राथमिक कार्य योजना बनाना, बजट तैयार करना, संगठित करना, कर्मचारियों का समन्वय करना और प्रणाली में स्थिरता तथा पूर्वानुमेय दक्षता सुनिश्चित करना होता है। इसके विपरीत, नेतृत्व का मुख्य कार्य परिवर्तन का प्रबंधन करना, दिशा तय करना, लोगों को साझा दृष्टिकोण से जोड़ना और यथास्थिति को चुनौती देना है।
- विकल्प (A) गलत है क्योंकि भविष्य का दृष्टिकोण तय करना और यथास्थिति को बदलना नेतृत्व का मूल कार्य है।
- विकल्प (B) गलत है क्योंकि अभूतपूर्व नवाचारों के लिए जोखिम उठाना परिवर्तनकारी नेतृत्व का लक्षण है, जबकि प्रबंधक जोखिम को न्यूनतम कर स्थिरता बनाए रखते हैं।
- विकल्प (D) गलत है क्योंकि करिश्माई प्रेरणा और भावनात्मक जुड़ाव पैदा करना करिश्माई एवं रूपांतरणकारी नेतृत्व का गुण है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (C) Planning, organizing, and maintaining system stability.

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Management theory distinguishes managers from leaders based on primary administrative focus. A manager focuses on establishing structure, planning budgets, organizing resources, enforcing rules, and maintaining operational stability within systems. Conversely, a leader emphasizes setting a visionary direction, inspiring followers, fostering alignment, and driving transformational change to challenge established organizational status quo patterns.

question_hindi: रॉबर्ट के. ग्रीनलीफ द्वारा प्रतिपादित वह कौन-सा नेतृत्व दृष्टिकोण है, जो स्पष्ट रूप से इस बात पर बल देता है कि एक नेता की प्राथमिक नैतिक जिम्मेदारी अपने अनुयायियों की आवश्यकताओं की सेवा करना और उनके समग्र विकास को प्राथमिकता देना है?

question_english: Which leadership approach, originally conceptualized by Robert K. Greenleaf, explicitly emphasizes that a leader's primary ethical responsibility is to serve the needs of their followers and prioritize their holistic development?
options_english: Servant Leadership
Authority-Compliance Management
Authentic Leadership
Trait Theory
explanation_english:
The concept of 'Servant Leadership' was introduced by Robert K. Greenleaf in his seminal 1970 essay, 'The Servant as Leader.' Greenleaf argued that true leadership begins with the natural feeling that one wants to serve first. A servant leader places the needs of followers, employees, and the community ahead of their own personal ambitions or executive authority. Key characteristics of servant leadership include active listening, empathy, healing, self-awareness, persuasion rather than coercion, stewardship, and a deep commitment to the growth and empowerment of individuals.
- Option B is incorrect because 'Authority-Compliance Management' (Blake and Mouton 9,1 style) prioritizes task completion and production while largely treating human needs as secondary.
- Option C is incorrect because 'Authentic Leadership' focuses on self-awareness, relational transparency, internalized moral perspective, and balanced processing rather than Greenleaf's specific servant-first premise.
- Option D is incorrect because 'Trait Theory' suggests that leaders possess inherent, universal physical or psychological traits that differentiate them from non-leaders.
explanation_hindi:
'सेवक नेतृत्व' (सर्वेंट लीडरशिप) की अवधारणा को 1970 में रॉबर्ट के. ग्रीनलीफ ने अपने प्रसिद्ध निबंध में प्रतिपादित किया था। ग्रीनलीफ के अनुसार, उत्कृष्ट नेतृत्व की शुरुआत इस स्वाभाविक भावना से होती है कि व्यक्ति सबसे पहले दूसरों की सेवा करना चाहता है। एक सेवक नेता अपने व्यक्तिगत पद, शक्ति या सत्ता की तुलना में अपने अनुयायियों, शिक्षकों और विद्यार्थियों के कल्याण और विकास को सर्वोपरि रखता है। इसके प्रमुख लक्षणों में सक्रिय श्रवण, सहानुभूति, जागरूकता, प्रत्ययकारी संवाद, संरक्षण और लोगों के संवर्धन के प्रति निष्ठा शामिल हैं।
- विकल्प (B) गलत है क्योंकि 'अधिकार-अनुपालन प्रबंधन' में कार्य और उत्पादन पर पूरा जोर दिया जाता है तथा मानवीय आवश्यकताओं की उपेक्षा की जाती है।
- विकल्प (C) गलत है क्योंकि 'प्रामाणिक नेतृत्व' आत्म-जागरूकता, नैतिक दृष्टिकोण और पारदर्शी संबंधों पर केंद्रित होता है, न कि ग्रीनलीफ के सेवा-प्रथम सिद्धांत पर।

question_english: In an educational institution, upward communication from teaching staff to executive management is most severely impeded by:
options_english: An approachable, supportive, and empathetic leadership posture maintained by the Principal
Operating within a flat organizational structure characterized by decentralized administrative authority
Maintaining active, accessible suggestion mechanisms and grievance forums across departments
A rigid, authoritarian hierarchical climate where dissent or critical feedback is penalized
explanation_english:
Upward communication involves the upward transmission of information, feedback, classroom concerns, and constructive suggestions from frontline teaching and operational staff to higher administration. A rigid, punitive hierarchical culture where dissent, honest feedback, or criticism is penalized creates a climate of fear, distrust, and professional defensiveness. Consequently, faculty members withhold crucial observations regarding academic bottlenecks or student welfare issues, leading to severe information filtering, organizational distortion, and administrative isolation at the top.
- Option A is incorrect because an approachable, empathetic Principal encourages open dialogue and fosters trust, actively facilitating upward communication.
- Option B is incorrect because a flat organizational structure with decentralized authority reduces administrative layers and distances, making upward communication quicker and more transparent.
- Option C is incorrect because accessible suggestion boxes and feedback channels provide structured, safe avenues for staff input, thereby strengthening upward communication.
explanation_hindi:
उर्ध्वगामी संचार वह प्रक्रिया है जिसमें सूचनाएं, प्रतिपुष्टि (फीडबैक), जमीनी समस्याएं और रचनात्मक सुझाव निचले स्तर के शिक्षकों एवं कर्मचारियों से उच्च प्रशासन की ओर प्रवाहित होते हैं। यदि विद्यालय में एक कठोर, भययुक्त और पदानुक्रमित कार्य-संस्कृति है जहाँ असहमति व्यक्त करने या समस्याओं को उजागर करने पर प्रतिकूल प्रविष्टियां या दंडात्मक कार्रवाई की जाती है, तो कर्मचारी सच बोलने से डरते हैं। इससे सूचना का विरूपण होता है और उच्च प्रशासन वास्तविक शैक्षणिक समस्याओं से अनभिज्ञ रह जाता है।
- विकल्प (A) गलत है क्योंकि एक सुलभ और सहानुभूतिपूर्ण प्रधानाचार्य खुले संवाद को प्रोत्साहित करता है, जिससे उर्ध्वगामी संचार सुदृढ़ होता है।
- विकल्प (B) गलत है क्योंकि सपाट संरचना और विकेंद्रीकरण से पदानुक्रम की दूरियां घटती हैं और संचार अधिक सहज बनता है।
- विकल्प (C) गलत है क्योंकि सुझाव पेटियां और संवाद मंच कर्मचारियों को अपने विचार साझा करने के लिए सुरक्षित माध्यम प्रदान करते हैं।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (D) A rigid hierarchical culture where dissent is penalized.

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Upward communication involves messages flowing from lower-level staff to higher administration, providing feedback, suggestions, or reporting operational issues. A rigid hierarchical culture where dissent is penalized severely hinders this communication flow. Subordinates hesitate to voice concerns, report errors, or propose innovations due to fear of reprisal, leading to filtered communication and administrative isolation.

question_english:
Given below are two statements: one is labelled as Assertion (A) and the other is labelled as Reason (R).
Assertion (A): During the 'Change' (Moving) phase of Kurt Lewin's Three-Stage Model of Change, school administrators must anticipate and accommodate a temporary dip in institutional performance.
Reason (R): Navigating new pedagogical practices and administrative protocols requires staff to traverse a learning curve and exit familiar comfort zones, temporarily elevating confusion, cognitive load, and inefficiency.
In the light of the above statements, choose the most appropriate answer from the options given below:
options_english: Both (A) and (R) are true, and (R) is the correct explanation of (A)
Both (A) and (R) are true, but (R) is not the correct explanation of (A)
(A) is true, but (R) is false
(A) is false, but (R) is true
explanation_english:
Kurt Lewin's classic Three-Stage Model of Change consists of Unfreezing, Changing (or Moving), and Refreezing. During the 'Change' phase, the organization implements new structures, curriculum frameworks, or management procedures. It is well-documented in change management theory (often illustrated by the 'J-curve' of change) that organizational productivity and performance temporarily decline during this phase. This dip occurs precisely because employees and educators are abandoning established, comfortable habits and struggling with the steep learning curve of new tools, which temporarily heightens cognitive burden, stress, operational errors, and transitional inefficiency. Thus, Assertion (A) is true, Reason (R) is true, and (R) provides the direct causal explanation for (A).
- Options B, C, and D are incorrect because both statements are factually sound within organizational psychology, and the reason accurately explains why the performance decline occurs during the transition.
explanation_hindi:
कर्ट लेविन के प्रसिद्ध त्रि-चरणीय परिवर्तन मॉडल में तीन चरण शामिल हैं: अनफ्रीजिंग (विगलन), चेंजिंग/मूविंग (परिवर्तन), और रीफ्रीजिंग (पुनर्शीतलन)। 'परिवर्तन' चरण के दौरान नए व्यवहार, कार्यप्रणाली और तकनीकों को लागू किया जाता है। संगठनात्मक परिवर्तन सिद्धांत (परिवर्तन का जे-वक्र) के अनुसार, इस संक्रमणकालीन चरण में उत्पादकता में एक स्वाभाविक अस्थायी गिरावट आती है। इसका सीधा कारण यह है कि शिक्षक और कर्मचारी अपनी पुरानी जानी-पहचानी दिनचर्या को छोड़कर नई प्रणालियों को सीखने के दौर से गुजरते हैं, जिससे कार्य-निष्पादन में कुछ समय के लिए भ्रम, मानसिक तनाव और गलतियाँ बढ़ जाती हैं। अतः अभिकथन (A) और कारण (R) दोनों सत्य हैं, और (R), (A) की सटीक व्याख्या करता है।
- विकल्प (B), (C) और (D) गलत हैं क्योंकि दोनों कथन सैद्धांतिक रूप से पूर्णतः सही हैं और कारण स्पष्ट रूप से अभिकथन के पीछे के मनोवैज्ञानिक आधार को स्पष्ट करता है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (A) Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: During the Change stage of Kurt Lewin’s model, organizations often experience a temporary dip in performance. As employees abandon familiar routines to learn new systems, inefficiency, cognitive strain, and minor confusion temporarily increase. Because adjusting to new operational processes naturally involves a learning curve, the reason directly explains why institutional leaders must anticipate and accommodate this transitional performance drop.

question_english: In teacher performance appraisal and supervisory evaluation, the 'Halo Effect' refers to the cognitive bias wherein:
options_english: An appraiser rates all teaching personnel uniformly as 'Average' to avoid interpersonal conflict or administrative scrutiny
An evaluator assesses an educator's competence based almost exclusively on their most recent conduct and achievements
An appraiser's favorable impression of a single outstanding positive trait unduly inflates their ratings across all other performance dimensions
An appraiser deliberately assigns substandard marks to a subordinate due to personal grievance or underlying prejudice
explanation_english:
The 'Halo Effect', first identified empirically by psychologist Edward Thorndike in 1920, is a common cognitive bias in performance appraisals where an evaluator's global impression or positive assessment of one specific characteristic (such as exceptional punctuality, pleasant demeanor, or articulate verbal skills) disproportionately influences and inflates their rating of the individual across completely unrelated competencies (such as lesson planning, classroom management, or subject mastery). This cognitive distortion undermines objectivity and distorts professional developmental feedback.
- Option A is incorrect because rating everyone uniformly in the middle to avoid making difficult evaluations is known as the 'Central Tendency Bias'.
- Option B is incorrect because judging an employee's annual performance based predominantly on recent incidents rather than the entire appraisal period is known as the 'Recency Bias' (or recency error).
- Option D is incorrect because unfairly downgrading an employee due to prejudice or personal dislike is an instance of appraiser bias, personal prejudice, or the opposite 'Horns Effect'.
explanation_hindi:
'प्रभामंडल प्रभाव' (हेलो इफेक्ट), जिसे सर्वप्रथम मनोवैज्ञानिक एडवर्ड थार्नडाइक ने रेखांकित किया था, मूल्यांकन प्रक्रिया में एक प्रमुख संज्ञानात्मक पूर्वाग्रह है। इसमें मूल्यांकनकर्ता किसी शिक्षक के किसी एक प्रभावशाली सकारात्मक गुण (जैसे उत्कृष्ट समयबद्धता, सौम्य व्यवहार या प्रभावशाली वाकपटुता) से इतना प्रभावित हो जाता है कि वह शिक्षक के अन्य सभी असंबंधित क्षेत्रों (जैसे विषय-ज्ञान, शिक्षण विधियाँ, कक्षा प्रबंधन) में भी अत्यधिक अनुकूल और उच्च रेटिंग दे देता है। इससे मूल्यांकन की वस्तुनिष्ठता प्रभावित होती है।
- विकल्प (A) गलत है क्योंकि कठोर निर्णयों से बचने के लिए सभी को बीच की औसत रेटिंग देना 'केंद्रीय प्रवृत्ति पूर्वाग्रह' कहलाता है।
- विकल्प (B) गलत है क्योंकि पूरे वर्ष के बजाय केवल हाल की घटनाओं के आधार पर राय बनाना 'हालिया प्रभाव' कहलाता है।
- विकल्प (D) गलत है क्योंकि किसी एक नकारात्मक पहलू या व्यक्तिगत दुर्भावना के कारण संपूर्ण मूल्यांकन को खराब कर देना 'हॉर्न्स प्रभाव' कहलाता है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (C) Allowing one positive trait to overly influence all other ratings.

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: The Halo Effect is a cognitive bias in performance evaluation where an appraiser’s overall impression or perception of a single positive trait disproportionately influences ratings across all other performance categories. In teacher appraisal, an evaluator might rate an educator exceptionally high in overall competence simply because they excel in punctuality, undermining objective performance assessment.

question_english: Which of the following supervisory practices best exemplifies a 'Formative' approach to teacher appraisal?
options_english: Conducting a high-stakes annual evaluation exclusively to decide whether an increment or contract extension is granted
Using external standardized board examination pass rates as the sole quantitative metric of teaching competence
Issuing an administrative show-cause memorandum or formal punitive reprimand following a single pedagogical classroom slip
Conducting periodic developmental classroom observations accompanied by constructive, collaborative feedback
explanation_english:
Appraisal in educational management is classified into formative and summative evaluation. A formative approach focuses on developmental diagnostics, ongoing professional growth, and continuous instructional enhancement. Conducting periodic, non-threatening classroom observations followed by reflective dialogues and constructive feedback allows teachers to identify instructional blind spots, refine pedagogy, and strengthen pedagogical practices in real time without the fear of immediate administrative penalties.
- Option A is incorrect because high-stakes, end-of-year evaluations tied strictly to compensation, contract renewal, or promotions represent 'Summative Appraisal'.
- Option B is incorrect because relying solely on terminal student test results is a summative, quantitative accountability measure that provides no actionable qualitative pedagogical feedback.
- Option C is incorrect because issuing punitive memos for classroom slips represents authoritarian discipline, which undermines psychological safety and professional development.
explanation_hindi:
शैक्षणिक प्रबंधन में मूल्यांकन को रचनात्मक (फॉर्मेटिव) और संकलनात्मक (समेटिव) दृष्टिकोणों में वर्गीकृत किया जाता है। रचनात्मक मूल्यांकन का प्राथमिक उद्देश्य शिक्षक की कमियों को उजागर कर दण्डित करना नहीं, बल्कि उसकी निरंतर व्यावसायिक प्रगति और शिक्षण-अधिगम गुणवत्ता में सुधार करना होता है। समय-समय पर कक्षा का अवलोकन करना, अनुकूल वातावरण में चर्चा करना और सुधारात्मक प्रतिपुष्टि देना रचनात्मक मूल्यांकन की मूल भावना है। इससे शिक्षक बिना किसी प्रशासनिक भय के अपनी शिक्षण विधियों को बेहतर बना सकते हैं।
- विकल्प (A) गलत है क्योंकि वेतन वृद्धि या पदोन्नति के उद्देश्य से सत्र के अंत में किया जाने वाला अंतिम मूल्यांकन 'संकलनात्मक मूल्यांकन' कहलाता है।

question_english: Community participation mediated through the School Management Committee (SMC) primarily promotes governance transparency and institutional accountability by:
options_english: Conducting social audits of school operations, infrastructure projects, and institutional fund expenditures
Permitting parent representatives to unilaterally alter the daily academic timetable and curriculum pacing
Revoking the statutory administrative authority of the Principal over subordinate school staff
Bypassing the statutory norms, financial codes, and directives of the State Department of Education entirely
explanation_english:
Under the Right of Children to Free and Compulsory Education (RTE) Act, 2009, School Management Committees (SMCs)—comprising parents, teachers, and local authority representatives—serve as the principal instrument of democratic governance and grassroots social accountability. Conducting social audits is a vital mechanism through which the SMC examines school records, verifies the physical execution of civil works, tracks grants and resource allocations (such as composite school grants, mid-day meals, and textbook distributions), and ensures that public resources are utilized transparently without financial misappropriation or leakage.
- Option B is incorrect because academic timetables and pedagogical pacing fall strictly under the professional purview of teachers and academic coordinators, not unilateral parental intervention.
- Option C is incorrect because the SMC supports and collaborates with the Principal; it does not usurp the Principal's statutory administrative authority.
- Option D is incorrect because the SMC operates strictly within the framework of state educational regulations and statutory directives, rather than superseding them.

- विकल्प (D) गलत है क्योंकि एसएमसी राज्य सरकार और शिक्षा विभाग के स्थापित कानूनी नियमों के दायरे में ही कार्य करती है।

question_english: Contingency theories of leadership fundamentally propose that:
options_english: Leadership effectiveness depends on matching a leader's style to situational variables.
Universal leadership principles dictate that there is always one best administrative way to lead across all organizational situations.
Leadership capacity is entirely dependent on the inherent genetic traits, biological features, and innate personality of the leader.
Leaders must constantly alter their core personality characteristics and fundamental beliefs to match the expectations of followers.
explanation_english: The correct answer is (a). Contingency theories of leadership propose that no single leadership style is universally effective across all organizational scenarios. Instead, leadership effectiveness depends on matching a leader's behavioral orientation with specific situational characteristics, such as task complexity, leader authority, and group maturity. question_english: According to the Path-Goal Theory of leadership, the primary role and responsibility of a leader is to:

explanation_english: The correct answer is (a). The Path-Goal Theory of leadership, developed by Robert House, is grounded in the expectancy theory of motivation. question_english: The Situational Leadership Theory (SLT), which matches leadership style to the 'readiness' or 'maturity' of followers, was developed by:
options_english: Victor Vroom and Philip Yetton
Robert Blake and Jane Mouton
Kurt Lewin and Ronald Lippitt
Paul Hersey and Ken Blanchard
explanation_english: The correct answer is (d). Situational Leadership Theory (SLT) was developed by Paul Hersey and Kenneth Blanchard in the late 1960s. The model posits that effective leadership requires matching managerial behaviors to the maturity or readiness level of followers. Readiness is assessed by evaluating subordinates' task-specific ability and willingness, requiring leaders to dynamically alter their task and relationship behaviors across four distinct styles (Telling, Selling, Participating, Delegating). question_english: Leader-Member Exchange (LMX) Theory is unique among leadership theories because it focuses primarily on:

The innate physical, biological, and psychological traits of the leader

explanation_english: The correct answer is (b). question_english:
Given below are two statements: one is labelled as Assertion (A) and the other is labelled as Reason (R).
Assertion (A): The Behavioral Theory of leadership argues that leaders are born with immutable traits that determine their effectiveness.
Reason (R): Behavioral theories focus on observable actions, implying that leadership skills can be taught and developed.

In the light of the above statements, choose the correct answer from the options given below:
options_english: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
explanation_english: The correct answer is (d). Assertion (A) is false because the premise that leaders are born with innate, immutable traits belongs to the Trait Theory (or Great Man Theory) of leadership. In contrast, the Behavioral Theory arose specifically to challenge this notion, emphasizing that leadership is composed of observable behaviors and practices rather than genetic traits. Reason (R) is true because behavioral research (such as the Ohio State and Michigan studies) focuses on actions that can be observed, practiced, taught, and cultivated. Thus, Assertion (A) is false while Reason (R) is true.
explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (d) है। अभिकथन (A) गलत है क्योंकि यह मान्यता कि 'नेता जन्म लेते हैं, बनाए नहीं जाते' और वे अपरिवर्तनीय जन्मजात गुणों से युक्त होते हैं, नेतृत्व के 'विशेषक सिद्धांत' (Trait Theory / Great Man Theory) का मूल तत्व है, व्यवहारवादी सिद्धांत का नहीं। कारण (R) बिल्कुल सही है क्योंकि व्यवहारवादी सिद्धांतों (जैसे ओहायो स्टेट और मिशिगन अध्ययन) ने यह सिद्ध किया कि नेतृत्व विशिष्ट अवलोकनीय क्रियाओं और व्यवहारों का समुच्चय है, जिसका अर्थ यह है कि व्यक्तियों को प्रशिक्षण और अभ्यास के माध्यम से प्रभावी नेता बनाया जा सकता है। अतः A गलत है परन्तु R सही है।

question_english: According to LMX Theory, followers who are part of the leader’s ‘in-group’ typically experience:
options_english: Higher performance ratings, greater autonomy, and more communication
Strict adherence to formal job descriptions with no extra responsibilities
Lower levels of trust and fewer interactions with the leader
Frequent disciplinary actions and close supervision
explanation_english: The correct answer is (a). question_english: Which leadership theory, expanded by Bernard Bass, differentiates between leadership that maintains the status quo and leadership that inspires followers to transcend their self-interests for the good of the organization?

Blake and Mouton’s Managerial Grid Model

question_english: Bass identified four core components of Transformational Leadership, often referred to as the “Four I’s”. Which of the following is NOT one of them?
options_english: Idealized Influence
Inspirational Motivation
Intellectual Stimulation
Instrumental Control
explanation_english: The correct answer is (d). Bernard Bass conceptualized Transformational Leadership through four core components known as the Four I’s: Idealized Influence, Inspirational Motivation, Intellectual Stimulation, and Individualized Consideration. These components focus on charisma, vision, cognitive challenge, and personal empathy. Instrumental Control is not part of this framework; rather, authoritative control mechanisms align with transactional or bureaucratic administrative models. Options (a), (b), and (c) are all legitimate components of Bass's transformational leadership model.
explanation_hindi:
सही उत्तर (d) है। बर्नार्ड बास द्वारा प्रतिपादित रूपांतरणकारी नेतृत्व के चार घटक ('फोर आईज़') निम्नलिखित हैं:
1. आदर्श प्रभाव (Idealized Influence - रोल मॉडल के रूप में कार्य करना),
2. प्रेरणादायक अभिप्रेरणा (Inspirational Motivation - साझा दृष्टि से प्रेरित करना),

4. व्यक्तिगत विचार (Individualized Consideration - व्यक्तिगत मार्गदर्शन व संबल देना)।

I. Both studies identified two primary dimensions of leadership behavior: one focused on tasks, the other on people.

explanation_english: The correct answer is (a). Statements I, II, and III are correct, while statement IV is false. question_english: Transactional Leadership is primarily based on:
options_english: An exchange process where followers are rewarded for meeting goals

Relying primarily on the inherent personal charisma and extraordinary character of the organizational leader
Fostering and developing a deep, lasting emotional bond between institutional leaders and their followers
explanation_english: The correct answer is (a). Transactional Leadership is built upon a contractual exchange process between leaders and followers. Leaders set clear performance goals, define expectations, and establish standard operating procedures, offering rewards (contingent rewards) for compliance and target achievement. This approach relies on extrinsic motivators, formal authority, and monitoring performance to maintain organizational stability and achieve pre-determined operational standards efficiently. Option (b) is incorrect because transforming personal values is the defining role of Transformational Leadership. Option (c) is incorrect because charisma is central to Charismatic Leadership. Option (d) is incorrect because emotional bonding relates to relational and transformational styles rather than transactional exchange contracts.

question_english: Which component of Transactional Leadership involves the leader intervening only when standards are not met or when something goes wrong?

Passive Management by Exception
Non-Interventionist Laissez-faire Style
explanation_english: The correct answer is (c). question_english: A new Principal inherits a school with a highly experienced and highly motivated teaching staff (M4 readiness level). According to the Hersey-Blanchard Situational Leadership model, which style should the Principal adopt to maximize effectiveness?
options_english: Telling: Mandating rigid compliance and closely monitoring every detailed step of their daily classroom lesson plans

Participating: Forcing mandatory continuous joint decision-making sessions on every minor operational school issue
Delegating: Providing broad goals and allowing teachers autonomy to execute them
explanation_english: The correct answer is (d). Under the Hersey-Blanchard Situational Leadership model, an experienced, highly motivated staff displays M4 readiness, possessing both high competence (ability) and high commitment (willingness). For this group, the Delegating style (S4) is most effective. The leader provides broad objectives, necessary resources, and support while granting teachers high operational autonomy, avoiding unnecessary directive oversight or micromanagement that could undermine professional trust and motivation. question_english:
Given below are two statements: one is labelled as Assertion (A) and the other is labelled as Reason (R).
Assertion (A): In Fiedler’s Contingency Model, a leader’s LPC (Least Preferred Co-worker) score is considered flexible and easily changed depending on the situation.
Reason (R): Fiedler believed that leadership style is a reflection of personality, which is relatively stable and fixed.

In the light of the above statements, choose the correct answer from the options given below:
options_english: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
explanation_english: The correct answer is (d). In Fiedler’s Contingency Model, an individual’s Least Preferred Co-worker (LPC) score is viewed as a stable personality trait that remains relatively fixed rather than easily flexible. Fiedler believed leadership orientation reflects underlying personality structure, making it resistant to rapid change. Because individual leadership styles are relatively rigid, Fiedler argued that organizational effectiveness is achieved by matching the leader to the situation or changing the situational favorableness (job engineering), not by trying to change the leader's style. Thus, Assertion (A) is false, while Reason (R) is true.
explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (d) है। अभिकथन (A) असत्य है क्योंकि फ्रेड फिडलर के आकस्मिकता मॉडल में किसी नेता के एलपीसी (LPC) स्कोर को एक स्थिर और स्थायी व्यक्तित्व लक्षण माना जाता है, जिसे स्थिति के अनुसार बदला नहीं जा सकता। फिडलर का मानना था कि किसी नेता की बुनियादी नेतृत्व शैली को बदलना कठिन होता है, इसलिए नेतृत्व प्रभावशीलता बढ़ाने के लिए स्थिति को नेता के अनुकूल बनाना चाहिए (Job Engineering) अथवा स्थिति के अनुसार सही शैली वाले नेता का चयन करना चाहिए। कारण (R) बिल्कुल सही है क्योंकि फिडलर का यह स्पष्ट तर्क था कि नेतृत्व शैली अंतर्निहित व्यक्तित्व का प्रकटीकरण है, जो अपेक्षाकृत स्थायी व स्थिर होती है। अतः A गलत है परन्तु R सही है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (D) A is false but R is true

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: In Fiedler’s Contingency Model, an individual’s Least Preferred Co-worker (LPC) score is viewed as a stable personality trait that remains relatively fixed rather than easily flexible. Fiedler believed leadership orientation reflects underlying personality structure, making it resistant to rapid change. Thus, asserting the LPC score changes easily is false, while recognizing Fiedler’s view of fixed personality traits is accurate.

question_english: In Abraham Maslow’s Hierarchy of Needs model, which category of human needs is situated at the highest apex of the pyramid?
options_english: Esteem and Status Needs
Self-Actualization
Social Belonging Needs
Safety and Security Needs
explanation_english: The correct answer is (b). Abraham Maslow's Hierarchy of Needs structures human motives into a five-tier ascending pyramid: physiological needs at the base, followed by safety and security, social belongingness, esteem and status, and finally self-actualization at the apex. Self-actualization represents the highest psychological need—the ongoing drive to realize one's full personal potential, achieve self-fulfillment, and actualize individual creative capacities. Individuals seek self-actualization only after lower-order deficiency needs are substantially satisfied. Option (a), esteem needs, occupies the fourth tier just below the peak. Option (c), social belonging needs, resides on the third tier. Option (d), safety and security needs, occupies the second tier directly above basic physiological survival needs.
explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (b) है। अब्राहम मैस्लो के आवश्यकता पदानुक्रम सिद्धांत में मानवीय आवश्यकताओं को पाँच-स्तरीय पिरामिड के रूप में व्यवस्थित किया गया है। इस पदानुक्रम में सबसे नीचे शारीरिक आवश्यकताएँ, उसके ऊपर सुरक्षा आवश्यकताएँ, तीसरे स्तर पर सामाजिक/संबद्धता की आवश्यकताएँ, चौथे स्तर पर आत्म-सम्मान की आवश्यकताएँ और पिरामिड के सर्वोच्च शिखर पर आत्म-सिद्धि (Self-Actualization) स्थित होती है। आत्म-सिद्धि का तात्पर्य व्यक्ति द्वारा अपनी अंतर्निहित क्षमताओं, रचनात्मकता और व्यक्तिगत संभावनाओं को पूर्ण रूप से साकार करने की निरंतर प्रेरणा से है। यह आवश्यकता तभी प्रभावी होती है जब निचले स्तर की सभी बुनियादी आवश्यकताएँ संतुष्ट हो जाएँ। विकल्प (a) सम्मान संबंधी आवश्यकताएँ चौथे स्तर पर आती हैं। विकल्प (c) सामाजिक आवश्यकताएँ तीसरे स्तर पर होती हैं। विकल्प (d) सुरक्षा आवश्यकताएँ आधारभूत स्तर से ठीक ऊपर दूसरे पायदान पर स्थित होती हैं।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (B) Self-Actualization

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: In Abraham Maslow’s Hierarchy of Needs, Self-Actualization sits at the apex of the five-tier psychological model. It represents the ongoing drive to fulfill personal potential, achieve self-fulfillment, and realize individual capacities fully. Individuals seek self-actualization only after lower-order physiological, safety, social, and esteem needs are substantially satisfied, driving continuous personal growth and creative development.

question_english: According to Abraham Maslow’s motivational hierarchy, which of the following institutional measures would most effectively satisfy the ‘Esteem Needs’ of a school teacher?
options_english: Receiving official recognition like the ‘Best Teacher Award’ from the department
Consistently receiving a competitive monthly salary disbursed fully on time every month
Securing long-term institutional job tenure alongside comprehensive post-retirement pension benefits
Cultivating warm, friendly, and supportive interpersonal relations with departmental colleagues in the staff room
explanation_english: The correct answer is (a). In Maslow’s hierarchy, esteem needs encompass both internal self-respect (feeling competent, confident, and independent) and external recognition (prestige, status, official awards, and appreciation from superiors and peers). In an educational institution, receiving an official award like the 'Best Teacher Award' formally honors a teacher's competence and contributions, directly satisfying their need for professional esteem and prestige. Option (b) addresses basic economic and physiological survival needs through financial remuneration. Option (c) fulfills safety and security needs by providing permanent tenure and future retirement stability. Option (d) satisfies social belongingness and affiliation needs through warm interpersonal camaraderie among colleagues.
explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (a) है। अब्राहम मैस्लो के सिद्धांत में 'सम्मान संबंधी आवश्यकताओं' (Esteem Needs) के दो प्रमुख पहलू होते हैं: आंतरिक आत्म-सम्मान (दक्षता, आत्मविश्वास और स्वायत्तता) तथा बाह्य प्रतिष्ठा (पहचान, सामाजिक सम्मान, पद और प्रशंसा)। विद्यालय परिवेश में शिक्षा विभाग से 'सर्वश्रेष्ठ शिक्षक पुरस्कार' अथवा औपचारिक प्रशस्ति-पत्र प्राप्त होना शिक्षक की शिक्षण क्षमता, समर्पण और उपलब्धियों को सामाजिक मान्यता प्रदान करता है, जिससे उनकी सम्मान संबंधी आवश्यकताएँ प्रत्यक्ष रूप से संतुष्ट होती हैं। इसके विपरीत, विकल्प (b) समय पर वेतन मिलना आर्थिक व बुनियादी शारीरिक आवश्यकताओं से संबंधित है। विकल्प (c) स्थायी सेवा और पेंशन सुरक्षा आवश्यकताओं (Safety Needs) को पूरा करते हैं। विकल्प (d) सहकर्मियों के साथ सौहार्दपूर्ण संबंध सामाजिक और अपनत्व संबंधी आवश्यकताओं (Belongingness Needs) के अंतर्गत आते हैं।

question_english: Frederick Herzberg’s Two-Factor Theory of motivation distinguishes between ‘Hygiene Factors’ and ‘Motivators’. According to Herzberg, the presence of adequate Hygiene Factors in the workplace:
options_english: Directly generates exceptionally high levels of intrinsic employee motivation and overall workplace satisfaction
Invariably causes immediate, severe, and widespread operational job dissatisfaction across the organizational staff
Prevents job dissatisfaction without actively generating motivation
Fulfills the higher-order psychological self-actualization and self-fulfillment needs of organizational employees
explanation_english: The correct answer is (c). Frederick Herzberg’s Dual-Factor (Motivator-Hygiene) Theory posits that job satisfaction and job dissatisfaction are not opposite ends of a single continuum, but separate dimensions governed by distinct factors. Hygiene factors (such as administrative policies, working conditions, salary, supervisory relations, and job security) are extrinsic to the work itself. When adequate and favorable, they prevent employee dissatisfaction, creating an environment of 'no dissatisfaction'; however, they do not actively stimulate intrinsic motivation or job satisfaction. Active motivation requires intrinsic motivators (achievement, recognition, the work itself, responsibility, and personal growth). Option (a) is incorrect because hygiene factors cannot generate intrinsic motivation. Option (b) is incorrect because their presence prevents, rather than causes, dissatisfaction. Option (d) is incorrect because higher-order self-fulfillment needs are satisfied solely by motivators.
explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (c) है। फ्रेडरिक हर्ज़बर्ग के द्वि-कारक सिद्धांत (Two-Factor Theory) के अनुसार कार्य-संतुष्टि और कार्य-असंतोष एक ही पैमाने के दो विपरीत छोर नहीं हैं, बल्कि दो स्वतंत्र आयाम हैं। आरोग्य कारक (जैसे कार्य-दशाएँ, वेतन, प्रशासनिक नीतियाँ, नौकरी की सुरक्षा और पर्यवेक्षण) कार्य के बाह्य परिवेश से संबंधित होते हैं। हर्ज़बर्ग का स्पष्ट निष्कर्ष था कि कार्यस्थल पर आरोग्य कारकों की पर्याप्त उपस्थिति कर्मचारियों को कार्य-असंतोष से बचाती है ('असंतोष न होने' की तटस्थ स्थिति बनाती है), किंतु यह उनमें कार्य के प्रति आंतरिक अभिप्रेरणा या वास्तविक कार्य-संतुष्टि उत्पन्न नहीं करती। उच्च प्रेरणा केवल आंतरिक अभिप्रेरकों (जैसे उपलब्धि, मान्यता और संवृद्धि) द्वारा ही जागृत होती है। विकल्प (a) गलत है क्योंकि आरोग्य कारक आंतरिक प्रेरणा उत्पन्न नहीं करते। विकल्प (b) गलत है क्योंकि इनकी उपस्थिति असंतोष को दूर करती है, उत्पन्न नहीं करती। विकल्प (d) गलत है क्योंकि आत्म-सिद्धि उच्च स्तरीय अभिप्रेरकों से प्राप्त होती है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (C) Prevents job dissatisfaction without actively generating motivation.

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Herzberg’s Two-Factor Theory distinguishes between hygiene factors and motivators in the workplace. Hygiene factors, such as working conditions, salary, administrative policies, and job security, are extrinsic elements. According to Herzberg, providing adequate hygiene factors prevents employee dissatisfaction but does not actively generate intrinsic motivation or high job satisfaction, which require intrinsic motivators like achievement and recognition.

question_english: Which of the following is classified as a genuine ‘Motivator’ (rather than an extrinsic hygiene factor) in Frederick Herzberg’s Two-Factor Theory?
options_english: Physical working conditions and facilities in the school environment
Quality of interpersonal relations maintained with the school Principal
Base financial salary package and annual incremental pay raises
Personal achievement and professional recognition for good work
explanation_english: The correct answer is (d). In Herzberg's Dual-Factor Theory, 'Motivators' (satisfiers) are intrinsic factors derived directly from the content of the work and individual psychological growth. Examples include personal achievement, recognition, responsibility, meaningful challenging work, and advancement opportunities. These intrinsic motivators actively generate job satisfaction and drive individuals toward superior commitment and performance. In contrast, physical working conditions (Option a), interpersonal relationships with superiors (Option b), and basic financial salary/increments (Option c) are extrinsic 'Hygiene Factors' (or maintenance factors) that merely prevent workplace dissatisfaction without fostering genuine intrinsic motivation.
explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (d) है। फ्रेडरिक हर्ज़बर्ग के द्वि-कारक सिद्धांत में 'अभिप्रेरक' (Motivators) वे आंतरिक कारक हैं जो सीधे कार्य की विषय-वस्तु, कार्य की सार्थकता और व्यक्ति के व्यक्तिगत व व्यावसायिक विकास से जुड़े होते हैं। इनमें व्यक्तिगत उपलब्धि, उत्कृष्ट कार्य की पहचान व मान्यता, दायित्व, और पदोन्नति के अवसर शामिल हैं। ये कारक कर्मचारियों में सक्रिय रूप से उच्च कार्य-संतुष्टि उत्पन्न करते हैं और उन्हें उत्कृष्ट प्रदर्शन हेतु प्रेरित करते हैं। इसके विपरीत, भौतिक कार्य-दशाएँ (विकल्प a), प्रधानाचार्य के साथ पारस्परिक संबंध (विकल्प b) तथा बुनियादी वेतन व वार्षिक वेतन वृद्धि (विकल्प c) बाह्य 'आरोग्य कारक' (Hygiene Factors) हैं, जो केवल कार्य-असंतोष को दूर रखते हैं किंतु कर्मचारियों को आंतरिक रूप से अभिप्रेरित नहीं करते।

question_english:
Consider the following leadership styles identified in Robert House’s Path-Goal Theory:
I. Directive
II. Supportive
III. Participative
IV. Achievement-oriented
Which of the above leadership styles are available to a leader within the theory's behavioral repertoire?
options_english: I and II only
I, II and III only
II, III and IV only
I, II, III and IV
explanation_english: The correct answer is (d). Robert House's Path-Goal Theory of leadership identifies four distinct behavioral styles that leaders can flexibly exhibit depending on subordinate characteristics (such as locus of control, experience, and ability) and environmental demands (such as task structure, formal authority system, and work group dynamics): (1) Directive leadership—clarifying expectations, scheduling work, and establishing specific rules; (2) Supportive leadership—showing concern for subordinates' personal well-being and psychological comfort; (3) Participative leadership—consulting with followers and genuinely considering their inputs before making decisions; and (4) Achievement-oriented leadership—setting challenging performance goals, seeking continuous improvement, and expressing confidence in subordinates' competence. Because all four styles constitute the core repertoire of the theory, Option (d) is correct.
explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (d) है। रॉबर्ट हाउस के पथ-लक्ष्य सिद्धांत (Path-Goal Theory) के अनुसार एक नेता परिस्थिति, कार्य की प्रकृति और अधीनस्थों की विशेषताओं के अनुसार चार प्राथमिक नेतृत्व शैलियों का लचीलेपन से प्रयोग कर सकता है: (1) निर्देशात्मक नेतृत्व (Directive)—जिसमें कार्य के मानक, निर्देश और समय-सारणी स्पष्ट की जाती है; (2) सहायक नेतृत्व (Supportive)—जिसमें अधीनस्थों के कल्याण, सम्मान और व्यक्तिगत आवश्यकताओं का ध्यान रखा जाता है; (3) सहभागितापूर्ण नेतृत्व (Participative)—जिसमें निर्णय लेने से पूर्व अधीनस्थों से सुझाव और परामर्श लिया जाता है; और (4) उपलब्धि-उन्मुख नेतृत्व (Achievement-oriented)—जिसमें चुनौतीपूर्ण लक्ष्य निर्धारित किए जाते हैं और अधीनस्थों की उत्कृष्टता पर दृढ़ विश्वास दिखाया जाता है। चूंकि ये चारों शैलियाँ इस सिद्धांत के मूल व्यवहार संग्रह का हिस्सा हैं, अतः विकल्प (d) सही उत्तर है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (D) I, II, III and IV

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Robert House’s Path-Goal Theory identifies four distinct leadership styles available to managers: directive, supportive, participative, and achievement-oriented. Leaders can flex between these styles depending on subordinate characteristics and task demands. Directive style clarifies expectations, supportive builds rapport, participative involves consultation, and achievement-oriented sets high goals, providing a comprehensive behavioral repertoire for leaders.

question_english: Douglas McGregor’s classical formulation of ‘Theory X’ is predicated on the foundational assumption that:
options_english: Employees naturally view productive work as an inherently enjoyable and relaxing activity, comparable to play or rest
Workers inherently dislike work and require coercion to meet targets
Individuals will naturally exercise self-direction and strong self-control if they are committed to organizational objectives
The average human worker actively seeks out higher levels of administrative responsibility under supportive work conditions
explanation_english: The correct answer is (b). Douglas McGregor developed two contrasting behavioral frameworks describing managerial assumptions about human nature: Theory X and Theory Y. Theory X represents a traditional, negative view of employees. It assumes that the average human being possesses an inherent dislike of work and will avoid it whenever possible, lacks ambition, avoids responsibility, and prefers strict direction and security. Consequently, managers subscribing to Theory X believe that organizational goals can only be achieved through close supervision, strict directives, coercion, and external sanctions. In contrast, Options (a), (c), and (d) characterize McGregor's Theory Y, which views work as natural as play and recognizes employees' capacity for intrinsic motivation, self-control, and creative responsibility.
explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (b) है। डगलस मैकग्रेगर ने प्रबंधन में मानवीय व्यवहार को समझने के लिए दो परस्पर विरोधी दृष्टिकोण—'सिद्धांत X' और 'सिद्धांत Y' प्रतिपादित किए। सिद्धांत X एक पारंपरिक, रूढ़िवादी और नकारात्मक दृष्टिकोण प्रस्तुत करता है। इसकी मूल मान्यता है कि सामान्य कर्मचारी स्वभाव से कार्य से जी चुराते हैं, कार्य को नापसंद करते हैं, उनमें महत्वाकांक्षा की कमी होती है तथा वे उत्तरदायित्व से बचते हैं। अतः इस विचारधारा के अनुसार संस्थागत लक्ष्यों की प्राप्ति के लिए कर्मचारियों पर कठोर नियंत्रण, निरंतर निगरानी, कड़े नियम और दंडात्मक दबाव की आवश्यकता होती है। इसके विपरीत, विकल्प (a), (c) और (d) 'सिद्धांत Y' की सकारात्मक व मानवीय मान्यताओं को व्यक्त करते हैं, जहाँ कार्य को स्वाभाविक माना जाता है और कर्मचारी प्रतिबद्ध होने पर स्वयं स्व-निर्देशन व उत्तरदायित्व का निर्वहन करते हैं।

question_english: A school Principal who operates under the administrative assumptions of McGregor’s ‘Theory Y’ is most likely to:
options_english: Install extensive surveillance cameras inside classrooms to continuously monitor teacher movements and instructional delivery
Systematically withhold critical institutional information from teaching staff in order to preserve centralized administrative power
Use explicit threats of adverse Annual Confidential Report entries as the chief mechanism to enforce staff punctuality
Delegate responsibility and encourage teachers to take initiative
explanation_english: The correct answer is (d). McGregor’s Theory Y assumes that employees view work as natural, possess intrinsic motivation, seek professional responsibility, and exercise ingenuity and self-direction when properly supported. A school principal embracing Theory Y trusts the capabilities and dedication of teachers. Rather than relying on coercive controls or authoritarian oversight, such a leader delegates meaningful administrative and pedagogical authority, encourages teachers to design novel instructional strategies, and fosters collaborative decision-making. In contrast, Options (a), (b), and (c) embody Theory X practices, relying on continuous surveillance, information hoarding, and coercive threats of punitive appraisal ratings.
explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (d) है। मैकग्रेगर का सिद्धांत Y यह मानता है कि कर्मचारी स्वाभाविक रूप से कार्य को अपनी पहचान का हिस्सा मानते हैं, आत्म-निर्देशन में सक्षम होते हैं, नवाचार करना पसंद करते हैं तथा उत्तरदायित्व स्वीकार करने के लिए तैयार रहते हैं। सिद्धांत Y पर विश्वास करने वाला प्रधानाचार्य शिक्षकों की योग्यता और निष्ठा पर भरोसा करता है। वह शिक्षकों को निर्णय लेने की स्वतंत्रता और अधिकार सौंपता है (प्रत्यायोजन करता है), तथा उन्हें नए शैक्षणिक प्रयोगों और संस्थागत सुधारों में स्वैच्छिक पहल करने के लिए प्रेरित करता है। इसके विपरीत, विकल्प (a) कक्षाओं में कैमरों से निगरानी करना, विकल्प (b) प्रशासनिक सत्ता के लिए सूचनाएँ छिपाना तथा विकल्प (c) प्रतिकूल ACR की धमकियाँ देना—ये सभी सिद्धांत X के दमनकारी, अविश्वासपूर्ण और सत्तावादी तौर-तरीकों का प्रतिनिधित्व करते हैं।

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Douglas McGregor’s Theory Y assumes that employees view work as natural, possess self-direction, seek responsibility, and exercise creativity. question_hindi: विक्टर व्रूम के प्रत्याशा सिद्धांत (Expectancy Theory of Motivation) के अनुसार, किसी व्यक्ति की अभिप्रेरणा तीन प्रमुख चरों के गुणनफल का परिणाम होती है। ये तीन चर कौन-से हैं?
options_hindi: प्रत्याशा (Expectancy), साधनता/माध्यमिकता (Instrumentality), और संयोजकता/मूल्य (Valence)
प्राथमिक आवश्यकता, आंतरिक चालक (ड्राइव), और बाह्य प्रोत्साहन

question_english: Victor Vroom’s Expectancy Theory of motivation posits that an individual's motivation is determined as a multiplicative product of three key variables. These are:
options_english: Expectancy, Instrumentality, and Valence
Primary Need, Internal Drive, and External Incentive
Individual Existence, Interpersonal Relatedness, and Personal Growth
Environmental Hygiene, Intrinsic Motivation, and External Factors
explanation_english: The correct answer is (a). Victor Vroom’s Expectancy Theory (1964) is a cognitive process theory of motivation stating that an individual's motivation is the product of three conscious beliefs: Motivation = Expectancy × Instrumentality × Valence. 'Expectancy' (Effort → Performance) is the belief that greater effort will lead to successful performance. 'Instrumentality' (Performance → Reward) is the belief that successful performance will result in a specific organizational outcome or reward. 'Valence' is the personal value or attractiveness the individual places on that reward. Because these three variables interact multiplicatively, if any one of them is zero, the overall motivational force becomes zero. Option (b) reflects traditional behavioral drive-reduction theory. Option (c) describes Clayton Alderfer’s ERG Theory. Option (d) reflects Herzberg’s Two-Factor hygiene-motivator framework.
explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (a) है। विक्टर व्रूम द्वारा 1964 में प्रतिपादित प्रत्याशा सिद्धांत (Expectancy Theory) एक संज्ञानात्मक प्रक्रियात्मक सिद्धांत है। इसके अनुसार किसी व्यक्ति की अभिप्रेरक शक्ति तीन प्रमुख चरों के गुणनफल पर निर्भर करती है: अभिप्रेरणा = प्रत्याशा (Expectancy) × साधनता (Instrumentality) × संयोजकता (Valence)। 'प्रत्याशा' व्यक्ति का यह विश्वास है कि अधिक प्रयास से कार्य-निष्पादन में सफलता मिलेगी (प्रयास → निष्पादन)। 'साधनता' यह विश्वास है कि सफल निष्पादन के फलस्वरूप संस्थागत प्रतिफल या पुरस्कार अवश्य प्राप्त होगा (निष्पादन → प्रतिफल)। 'संयोजकता' उस प्रतिफल के प्रति व्यक्ति का व्यक्तिगत आकर्षण या मूल्यांकन है। चूंकि ये तीनों चर गुणात्मक रूप से जुड़े हैं, अतः इनमें से किसी एक का मान भी शून्य होने पर कुल अभिप्रेरणा शून्य हो जाती है। विकल्प (b) चालक-प्रोत्साहन मॉडल है। विकल्प (c) एल्डरफर का ERG सिद्धांत है। विकल्प (d) हर्ज़बर्ग के कारकों से संबंधित है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (A) Expectancy, Instrumentality, and Valence

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Victor Vroom’s Expectancy Theory is a process theory of motivation stating that motivation results from three conscious expectations: Expectancy, Instrumentality, and Valence. Expectancy is the belief that effort leads to performance, Instrumentality is the belief that performance yields rewards, and Valence is the value placed on those rewards. Motivation equals the multiplicative product of these elements.

question_english: Within the framework of Victor Vroom’s Expectancy Theory, the term ‘Instrumentality’ refers to:

explanation_english: The correct answer is (c). In Vroom’s Expectancy Theory, 'Instrumentality' represents the perceived performance-to-reward probability (P → O). It is the employee's belief or expectation that successfully achieving a designated level of performance will directly serve as an effective instrument for obtaining a desired organizational outcome or reward (such as promotion, recognition, merit pay, or tenure). It reflects the employee’s assessment of organizational fairness, integrity, and trust in institutional promises. In contrast, Option (a) defines 'Expectancy' (Effort → Performance). Option (b) defines 'Valence' (the desirability or value of the outcome). Option (d) describes situational operational tools, which do not represent a psychological expectancy variable.
explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (c) है। विक्टर व्रूम के प्रत्याशा सिद्धांत में 'साधनता / माध्यमता' (Instrumentality) कार्य-निष्पादन और प्रतिफल के मध्य संबंध (निष्पादन → प्रतिफल) को दर्शाती है। इसका तात्पर्य कर्मचारी के इस विश्वास से है कि यदि वह अपेक्षित स्तर का कार्य-निष्पादन प्राप्त कर लेता है, तो संस्था उसे वांछित प्रतिफल या पुरस्कार (जैसे पदोन्नति, वेतन वृद्धि, या आधिकारिक प्रशंसा) प्रदान करने का साधन बनेगी। यह धारणा संस्था की निष्पक्षता, विश्वसनीयता और नीतियों की पारदर्शिता पर कर्मचारी के भरोसे को व्यक्त करती है। इसके विपरीत, विकल्प (a) 'प्रत्याशा' (Expectancy / प्रयास → निष्पादन) की परिभाषा है। विकल्प (b) 'संयोजकता' (Valence / प्रतिफल का मूल्य या आकर्षण) को दर्शाता है। विकल्प (d) केवल भौतिक संसाधनों का उल्लेख करता है जो मनोवैज्ञानिक अभिप्रेरणा घटक नहीं है।

options_english: Instrumentality
Effort Expectancy
Reward Valence
Environmental Hygiene
explanation_english: The correct answer is (a). In the given scenario, the teacher believes that high performance will not lead to the desired organizational reward (promotion recommendation). In Victor Vroom’s Expectancy Theory, the perceived probability linking performance to an outcome is termed 'Instrumentality'. When an employee perceives that performance outcomes yield no reward due to administrative bias, favoritism, or lack of institutional objectivity, Instrumentality approaches zero. Because motivation is determined multiplicatively (Motivation = Expectancy × Instrumentality × Valence), a zero Instrumentality entirely collapses motivation. Option (b), Effort Expectancy, is intact because the teacher believes they can work hard and achieve the target. Option (c), Reward Valence, is intact because promotion remains desirable. Option (d), Environmental Hygiene, belongs to Herzberg's theory, not Vroom's.
explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (a) है। प्रस्तुत परिदृश्य में शिक्षक यह मानता है कि वह कठोर परिश्रम और उच्च कार्य-प्रदर्शन कर सकता है, किंतु उसे विश्वास है कि उसके इस प्रदर्शन के बावजूद प्रधानाचार्य पदोन्नति की संस्तुति नहीं करेंगे। यहाँ निष्पादन और प्रतिफल (पदोन्नति) के मध्य का संबंध टूट चुका है। व्रूम के सिद्धांत में इस संबंध को 'साधनता' (Instrumentality) कहा जाता है। जब किसी कर्मचारी को यह लगता है कि संस्थागत पक्षपात या प्रशासनिक कमियों के कारण अच्छे कार्य का कोई फल नहीं मिलेगा, तो साधनता शून्य हो जाती है। चूंकि अभिप्रेरणा तीनों घटकों का गुणनफल होती है, अतः साधनता शून्य होते ही कुल अभिप्रेरणा समाप्त हो जाती है। विकल्प (b) प्रयास प्रत्याशा यहाँ विद्यमान है क्योंकि शिक्षक कार्य करने में सक्षम है। विकल्प (c) संयोजकता भी है क्योंकि शिक्षक पदोन्नति चाहता है। विकल्प (d) हर्ज़बर्ग के मॉडल से संबंधित है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (A) Instrumentality

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: When a teacher believes high effort will not result in a promotion, the perceived link between performance and outcome is severed. In Vroom’s Expectancy Theory, this connection represents Instrumentality. If an employee perceives that performance outcomes yield no reward due to administrative bias or policy gaps, Instrumentality approaches zero, resulting in low motivation regardless of effort or desire.

question_hindi: किसी शिक्षण संस्थान में नए पाठ्यक्रम दिशा-निर्देशों के संबंध में प्रधानाचार्य से शिक्षण कर्मचारियों की ओर प्रवाहित होने वाले संप्रेषण को क्या कहा जाता है?

question_english: Communication within an educational organisation that flows from the Principal to the teaching staff regarding new syllabus guidelines is termed:
options_english: Upward communication
Horizontal communication
Diagonal communication
Downward communication
explanation_english: The correct answer is (d). Downward communication is the transmission of information, policies, directives, and instructional guidelines from higher administrative tiers to subordinate operational levels within an organizational hierarchy. In a school setting, directives, circulars, and syllabus modifications communicated by the Principal to the teaching faculty constitute downward communication. This flow ensures organizational alignment, clarifies standard operating procedures, and conveys institutional goals from leadership to staff. Option (a), upward communication, flows from subordinates to executive superiors (e.g., teachers submitting reports, suggestions, or grievances). Option (b), horizontal communication, occurs laterally between peers at the same hierarchical tier (e.g., peer coordination between teachers). Option (c), diagonal communication, crosses both functional disciplines and hierarchical levels.
explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (d) है। संगठनात्मक पदानुक्रम में उच्च प्रशासनिक स्तर से अधीनस्थ स्तर की ओर प्रवाहित होने वाली आधिकारिक सूचनाओं, नीतियों, परिपत्रों और दिशा-निर्देशों को 'अधोगामी संप्रेषण' (Downward Communication) कहा जाता है। विद्यालय में प्रधानाचार्य द्वारा शिक्षकों को पाठ्यक्रम संबंधी दिशा-निर्देश या प्रशासनिक आदेश देना इसका सटीक उदाहरण है। यह संप्रेषण संस्थागत लक्ष्यों की स्पष्टता, नियमों के पालन और समन्वय को सुनिश्चित करता है। विकल्प (a) ऊर्ध्वगामी संप्रेषण (Upward communication) में सूचना निचले स्तर से उच्च स्तर की ओर जाती है (जैसे शिक्षकों द्वारा रिपोर्ट या प्रतिपुष्टि प्रस्तुत करना)। विकल्प (b) क्षैतिज संप्रेषण (Horizontal communication) समान प्रशासनिक स्तर के सहकर्मियों के बीच होता है। विकल्प (c) विकर्णीय संप्रेषण (Diagonal communication) विभिन्न विभागों और विभिन्न पदानुक्रमों के मध्य आड़ा-तिरछा होता है।

question_english: In organizational communication, the term ‘Grapevine’ refers to:
options_english: The formal, written statutory administrative circulars issued periodically by the educational authority
The informal, unofficial communication network within the school organization
The structured, monthly administrative staff meetings convened formally by the Head of School
The external media relations and official public communications handled by institutional spokespersons
explanation_english: The correct answer is (b). The 'Grapevine' is the informal, unofficial interpersonal communication network that operates naturally within every organization alongside formal channels. It stems from spontaneous social interactions, peer conversations, rumors, and camaraderie among employees. While it can transmit unverified rumors, it operates rapidly, satisfies social needs, provides valuable psychological catharsis, and offers school leaders insight into underlying employee morale, sentiments, and workplace climate. Option (a) describes formal vertical written circulars. Option (c) describes structured formal administrative meetings. Option (d) describes external public relations and communications.
explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (b) है। संगठनात्मक व्यवहार में 'जनप्रवाद' या 'अंगूरलता संप्रेषण' (Grapevine) से तात्पर्य संस्था के कर्मचारियों के मध्य स्वतः विकसित होने वाले अनौपचारिक और अनाधिकारिक संप्रेषण नेटवर्क से है। यह औपचारिक प्रशासनिक चैनलों के समानांतर चलता है और कर्मचारियों के सामाजिक मेलजोल, व्यक्तिगत संबंधों और अनौपचारिक चर्चाओं से पोषित होता है। यद्यपि इसमें कभी-कभी अपुष्ट जानकारियाँ या अफवाहें फैल सकती हैं, फिर भी यह अत्यंत तीव्र गति से कार्य करता है, कर्मचारियों के सामाजिक जुड़ाव को बढ़ाता है और संस्था के आंतरिक परिवेश व कर्मचारियों के मनोबल को समझने के लिए प्रशासक को महत्वपूर्ण संकेत प्रदान करता है। विकल्प (a) औपचारिक लिखित परिपत्रों को दर्शाता है। विकल्प (c) संरचित आधिकारिक बैठकों से संबंधित है। विकल्प (d) बाह्य मीडिया और जनसंपर्क का हिस्सा है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (B) The informal, unofficial communication network within the school organization.

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: The grapevine refers to the informal, unofficial communication network that operates alongside formal administrative channels in an organization. question_english: Which of the following acts as a ‘Semantic Barrier’ to effective organizational communication in a school?
options_english: Environmental disruption caused by loud noise originating from an adjacent construction site during instructional delivery
Physical structural barriers such as the school Principal’s office door being continuously locked during operational hours
Use of complex pedagogical jargon that new teachers cannot understand
Deep-seated personal psychological prejudices held by the message receiver directly against the administrative sender
explanation_english: The correct answer is (c). A semantic barrier arises when differences in language, symbols, technical terms, or vocabulary distort the sender's intended meaning, causing misinterpretation. The excessive use of complex pedagogical jargon, specialized terminology, or ambiguous acronyms that newly recruited teachers cannot comprehend represents a textbook semantic barrier. Option (a) is an environmental/physical barrier (auditory noise). Option (b) is a physical/structural barrier (spatial separation and locked access). Option (d) is a psychological/interpersonal barrier (personal prejudice and emotional bias).
explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (c) है। संप्रेषण प्रक्रिया में 'अर्थ-संबंधी / भाषा-संबंधी अवरोध' (Semantic Barrier) तब उत्पन्न होता है जब भाषा, शब्दों, प्रतीकों या पारिभाषिक शब्दावली की जटिलता के कारण प्राप्तकर्ता संदेश के अभीष्ट अर्थ को ग्रहण नहीं कर पाता। ऐसी जटिल शैक्षणिक शब्दावली (Pedagogical Jargon) या तकनीकी शब्दों का उपयोग जिसे नए शिक्षक न समझ सकें, अर्थ-संबंधी अवरोध का स्पष्ट उदाहरण है। इसके विपरीत, विकल्प (a) निकटवर्ती निर्माण कार्य का शोर एक भौतिक/पर्यावरणीय अवरोध है। विकल्प (b) प्रधानाचार्य के कार्यालय का बंद दरवाजा एक भौतिक/संरचनात्मक अवरोध है। विकल्प (d) संदेश प्रेषक के प्रति पूर्वाग्रह एक मनोवैज्ञानिक अवरोध का उदाहरण है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (C) Use of complex pedagogical jargon that new teachers cannot understand.

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: A semantic barrier in communication occurs when differences in language, symbols, or terminology distort the intended meaning of a message. Using complex pedagogical jargon or specialized vocabulary that receivers cannot interpret creates confusion and misunderstanding. Unlike physical noise or psychological biases, semantic barriers stem directly from linguistic choices and ambiguous word meanings during message transmission.

question_hindi: संगठनों में द्वंद्व/संघर्ष प्रबंधन हेतु प्रायः थॉमस-किल्मन द्वंद्व समाधान मॉडल (TKI) का उपयोग किया जाता है। वह शैली जो अत्यधिक दृढ़/आग्रही (Assertive) और अत्यंत असहयोगात्मक (Uncooperative) होती है, क्या कहलाती है?

परिहार्य / टालने वाली शैली (Avoiding)

question_english: Conflict management in organisations often utilizes the Thomas-Kilmann Conflict Mode Instrument. A style that is highly assertive and highly uncooperative is termed:
options_english: Accommodating
Avoiding
Compromising
Competing
explanation_english: The correct answer is (d). The Thomas-Kilmann Conflict Mode Instrument (TKI) defines conflict-handling behavior along two foundational dimensions: assertiveness (the extent to which an individual attempts to satisfy their own concerns) and cooperativeness (the extent to which an individual attempts to satisfy the concerns of others). A style characterized by high assertiveness and low cooperativeness is termed 'Competing'. When using a competing style, an individual aggressively pursues their own objectives at the other party's expense, utilizing positional authority, hierarchical power, or forceful arguments to win. Option (a), accommodating, represents low assertiveness and high cooperativeness. Option (b), avoiding, represents low assertiveness and low cooperativeness. Option (c), compromising, represents intermediate levels of both assertiveness and cooperativeness.
explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (d) है। थॉमस-किल्मन द्वंद्व समाधान मॉडल (Thomas-Kilmann Conflict Mode Instrument) के अनुसार द्वंद्व के समय मानवीय व्यवहार दो आयामों पर आधारित होता है: आग्रहिता (दृढ़ता - अपने हितों की पूर्ति का प्रयास) और सहकारिता (दूसरों के हितों की पूर्ति का प्रयास)। वह शैली जो अत्यधिक आग्रही (High Assertiveness) और निम्न सहयोगात्मक (Low Cooperativeness) होती है, 'प्रतिस्पर्धी शैली' (Competing) कहलाती है। इस शैली में व्यक्ति दूसरे पक्ष की चिंताओं की उपेक्षा करते हुए अपनी बात मनवाने के लिए पद, सत्ता, शक्ति या कठोर तर्कों का सहारा लेता है। विकल्प (a) समायोजनकारी शैली (Accommodating) में निम्न आग्रहिता और उच्च सहकारिता होती है। विकल्प (b) परिहार्य शैली (Avoiding) में दोनों निम्न होते हैं। विकल्प (c) समझौतावादी शैली (Compromising) दोनों के बीच संतुलन स्थापित करती है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (D) Competing

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: In the Thomas-Kilmann Conflict Mode Instrument, conflict management styles are mapped across assertiveness and cooperativeness dimensions. A style characterized by high assertiveness and low cooperativeness is termed Competing. Individuals using this approach pursue their own concerns at the expense of others, relying on positional power, formal authority, or arguments to achieve their desired outcome.

question_english:
Given below are two statements: one is labelled as Assertion (A) and the other is labelled as Reason (R).
Assertion (A): In LMX Theory, followers in the ‘in-group’ generally experience higher job satisfaction and lower turnover intentions.
Reason (R): In-group members have high-quality exchanges with the leader, receiving more resources, support, and autonomy.
In the light of the above statements, choose the most appropriate answer from the options given below:
options_english: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
explanation_english: The correct answer is (a). George Graen's Leader-Member Exchange (LMX) Theory conceptualizes leadership as a series of unique dyadic relationships between a leader and individual followers, resulting in the formation of an 'in-group' and an 'out-group'. In-group subordinates enjoy high-quality developmental exchanges characterized by mutual respect, trust, bidirectional influence, and shared responsibilities. Consequently, leaders allocate more administrative resources, personalized mentorship, challenging assignments, and decision-making latitude to in-group members, making Reason (R) true. Because this enriched, supportive interpersonal dynamic directly enhances job satisfaction, organizational commitment, and retention, Reason (R) correctly explains Assertion (A). Options (b), (c), and (d) are therefore incorrect.
explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (a) है। जॉर्ज ग्रेन द्वारा प्रतिपादित नेता-सदस्य विनिमय सिद्धांत (LMX Theory) यह व्याख्या करता है कि नेता अपने सभी subordinates (अधीनस्थों) के साथ एक समान संबंध नहीं रखते, बल्कि व्यक्तिगत संबंधों के आधार पर वे 'इन-ग्रुप' (अंतःसमूह) और 'आउट-ग्रुप' (बाह्य-समूह) का निर्माण करते हैं। अंतःसमूह के सदस्यों के नेता (प्रधानाचार्य) के साथ उच्च-गुणवत्तापूर्ण संबंध होते हैं, जिसके कारण उन्हें अधिक संस्थागत संसाधन, भावनात्मक समर्थन, विश्वास और निर्णय लेने की स्वायत्तता प्राप्त होती है (अतः कारण R सही है)। इस सकारात्मक और संवर्धक परिवेश के सीधे परिणाम स्वरूप अंतःसमूह के सदस्यों में उच्च कार्य-संतुष्टि पाई जाती है और वे संस्था छोड़कर नहीं जाते (अतः अभिकथन A सही है)। चूंकि कारण (R) सीधे तौर पर अभिकथन (A) का तार्किक आधार स्पष्ट करता है, इसलिए (A) और (R) दोनों सही हैं तथा (R), (A) की सही व्याख्या है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (A) Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A

question_english: In the Thomas-Kilmann Conflict Mode Instrument, the ‘Collaborating’ style of conflict resolution is characterised by:
options_english: Low assertiveness and high cooperativeness
High assertiveness and high cooperativeness
Moderate assertiveness and moderate cooperativeness
Low assertiveness and low cooperativeness
explanation_english: The correct answer is (b). In the Thomas-Kilmann model, the 'Collaborating' conflict-handling style combines high assertiveness with high cooperativeness. It represents an integrative, win-win strategy in which both parties work together to uncover the underlying needs and concerns of each side, exploring alternative options to create a mutually beneficial solution where nobody has to make unnecessary sacrifices. Collaborating requires open dialogue, interpersonal trust, and creative problem-solving. Option (a) describes 'Accommodating' (neglecting one's own concerns to satisfy others). Option (c) describes 'Compromising' (finding an expedient, mutually acceptable middle ground). Option (d) describes 'Avoiding' (withdrawing from or postponing the conflict).
explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (b) है। थॉमस-किल्मन मॉडल में द्वंद्व समाधान की 'सहयोगात्मक शैली' (Collaborating Style) उच्च आग्रहिता (High Assertiveness) और उच्च सहकारिता (High Cooperativeness) दोनों का समन्वित रूप है। यह एक 'जीत-जीत' (Win-Win) दृष्टिकोण है, जिसमें दोनों पक्ष खुले संवाद, आपसी विश्वास और रचनात्मक समस्या-समाधान के माध्यम से विवाद के मूल कारणों की पहचान करते हैं और ऐसा समाधान निकालते हैं जो दोनों पक्षों के हितों को पूर्ण रूप से संतुष्ट करता हो। इसके विपरीत, विकल्प (a) समायोजन (Accommodating) को दर्शाता है। विकल्प (c) समझौता (Compromising) को दर्शाता है जहाँ दोनों पक्षों को कुछ न कुछ त्याग करना पड़ता है। विकल्प (d) परिहार (Avoiding) को दर्शाता है जहाँ विवाद से बचने का प्रयास किया जाता है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (B) High assertiveness and high cooperativeness.

question_english: Kurt Lewin’s prominent three-step model for Change Management involves which sequence?
options_english: Plan, Do, Review
Unfreeze, Change, Refreeze
Direct, Support, Delegate
Assess, Implement, Evaluate
explanation_english: The correct answer is (b). Kurt Lewin's classic planned change model conceptualizes change in social systems through three sequential steps: (1) Unfreezing—destabilizing the current equilibrium, overcoming organizational inertia, and fostering psychological readiness for change; (2) Changing (or Moving)—transitioning toward the desired future state by implementing new behaviors, values, operational structures, and practices; and (3) Refreezing—reinforcing and stabilizing the new behaviors and organizational arrangements into daily routines, organizational culture, and permanent administrative procedures to prevent regression to old patterns. Option (a) reflects Deming's continuous improvement cycle. Option (c) reflects Hershey-Blanchard situational leadership behaviors. Option (d) represents standard project assessment phases.
explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (b) है। प्रसिद्ध सामाजिक मनोवैज्ञानिक कर्ट लेविन का परिवर्तन प्रबंधन मॉडल तीन क्रमिक चरणों पर आधारित है: (1) असमीकरण या विगलन (Unfreezing)—जिसमें वर्तमान स्थिति की जड़ता को तोड़कर और पुरानी कार्यप्रणालियों पर पुनर्विचार करके परिवर्तन के लिए तत्परता उत्पन्न की जाती है; (2) परिवर्तन (Change/Moving)—जिसमें नई कार्यप्रणालियों, विचारों और संरचनाओं को संस्था में लागू किया जाता है; तथा (3) पुनर्जमीकरण (Refreezing)—जिसमें लागू किए गए नए व्यवहारों और प्रणालियों को संस्थागत संस्कृति और नियमों में स्थायी रूप दिया जाता है ताकि कर्मचारी दोबारा पुरानी आदतों की ओर न लौटें। विकल्प (a) डेमिंग का गुणवत्ता चक्र है। विकल्प (c) स्थितिजन्य नेतृत्व की शैलियाँ हैं। विकल्प (d) सामान्य मूल्यांकन प्रक्रिया है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (B) Unfreeze, Change, Refreeze

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Kurt Lewin’s classic Change Management model consists of three sequential stages: Unfreeze, Change, and Refreeze. Unfreezing prepares the organization by dismantling current mindsets and creating readiness for change. The Change stage implements new behaviors, processes, or structures. Refreezing solidifies these updates, embedding them into organizational habits, systems, and institutional culture to sustain long-term change.
